about_the_game:
A mysterious figure draws you into the game. Price: death. Executioner: you. You have dice in your hand and the consequences of this game on your shoulders. Act, predict, observe, and above all... cheat? How long will you last before your conscience takes your minds away? How long will you last before you throw away your values? Do you think you are capable of making sacrifices in the name of honor? The time of trial has come. Even if the die has been cast, let your decisions determine you.

The die is cast

Your fate has been sealed, hasn't it? Observe your surroundings, look for solutions, develop a strategy, try to change the outcome of the roll to achieve your goals.

There will come an end for everyone

And it will be whatever you decide with fate. Will it be a happy one, and if so, for whom? Is it possible to arrange the turns in such a way as to save yourself and the world? You have to judge it for yourself and find the one that lets you sleep in peace.

It's a problem you're here

Alone. Up in the air. In the midst of explosions. With decisions to be made. With an open question: what next? No one to help you. No hints. No UI. Fully immersed in a life-and-death game.

The game is just beginning

And now that you have the dice in your hands, know that in the demo version you will mainly familiarize yourself with the basic gameplay. If you are observant and clever enough, you will also discover several ways to effectively duel with fate. You will be able to experience three full endings and get on the road to the fourth. The rest of the game... The rest of the game is now shrouded in silence.

content_descriptors.notes: Use of tobacco. Descriptions of war. Suicide.
